data.title: Analyst Maintains Buy Rating on Scienture, Keeps 12-Month Price Target Unchanged at $1.50 on Strength of Arbli Commercial Progress
data.description:
Maxim Group analyst Naz Rahman reiterated a Buy rating on Scienture Holdings yesterday and set a price target of $1.50.

Naz Rahman has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, starting with Scienture’s progress in commercializing its lead drug Arbli. The product’s recent addition to formularies at three prominent U.S. pediatric academic centers is expected to broaden coverage, enhance physician awareness, and steadily drive prescription growth as the launch continues.

Rahman also highlights Arbli’s differentiated profile as the only FDA-approved ready-to-use oral liquid losartan in the U.S., targeting a sizable hypertension market and a meaningful subset of patients who struggle to swallow tablets. Together with Rezenopy, Scienture is addressing niche but commercially attractive unmet needs, and Rahman’s valuation work on these two assets supports maintaining a 12-month price target of $1.50, underpinning his Buy recommendation.

data.title: Rivian Sell Rating Reiterated as Long-Term Risks Persist; Price Target Maintained at $14
data.description:
Analyst Andrew Percoco from Morgan Stanley maintained a Sell rating on Rivian Automotive and keeping the price target at $14.00.

Andrew Percoco has given his Sell rating due to a combination of factors related to Rivian’s long‑term execution risk and valuation versus its fundamentals. While the company delivered and produced materially more vehicles than expected in 3Q26 and kept its full‑year delivery guidance intact, he views the sustainability and mix of this strength as critical, particularly around the ramp of the R2 platform.

Percoco is concerned that if recent upside is driven mainly by R1 and EDV volumes, uncertainty around R2 scaling, profitability, and cash needs could continue to weigh on the equity story despite near‑term operational beats. With these strategic and financial risks still elevated, he maintains a cautious stance and reiterates a Sell rating, leaving his price target unchanged at $14.
